criteria: Pronounces ă, â/î, ș, ț and the ce/ci/che/chi family correctly in a short reading
Correctly conjugates a fi and a avea in at least four persons each
States the gender of at least 8 out of 10 common nouns and forms a correct plural
Produces both the indefinite article and the suffixed definite article correctly for at least 6 nouns
S01_A1_Grammar_Basics.pass_threshold: The learner reads a short Romanian text aloud with correct stress and diacritic sounds, states the gender of 10 common nouns, and produces both the definite and indefinite forms of at least 8 nouns without prompting.

criteria: Listening and reading comprehension consistent with the target CEFR level's can-do descriptors, using material from that level's stages
Spoken interaction and spoken production consistent with the target level's can-do descriptors, with grammar from that level's stages used accurately enough not to obstruct communication
Writing consistent with the target level's can-do descriptor and task type (from a postcard at A1 up to a structured report/essay at C1-C2)

Grammar and vocabulary specific to Romanian (gender and the suffixed definite article at A1-A2, subjunctive and imperfect at B1, full subjunctive/conditional/passive/vocative at B2, register and idiom at C1-C2, as relevant to the level being tested) applied accurately enough for the target level's expected standard
No level is certified as passed until every stage belonging to that CEFR level shows a passed test in the micro-profile
exam_rubric.pass_threshold: Consistent, unprompted performance against the CEFR can-do descriptors for the learner's current target CEFR level, across all four skill areas (listening, reading, a combined spoken interaction/production section, and writing), graded holistically rather than by a fixed mark total, in the style of ILR's own level tests rather than a single cumulative pass/fail exam covering every level at once.

source_notes: Official ILR (Institutul Limbii Române) self-assessment sample tests, openly hosted on ilr.ro with no gating, were the original source used to confirm that Romanian language certification for foreign/heritage learners maps directly onto the six standard CEFR levels A1-C2.

Council of Europe CEFR Global Scale and Self-assessment Grid descriptor text was fetched directly and paraphrased into the 30 RO-<level>-CD-* items so that no single item is a verbatim long quotation.
